sections.overview: This small didelphid marsupial is the sole living species in the genus Hyladelphys; it was originally placed in Gracilinanus.
sections.identification: Adults are about 67–85 mm in head-and-body length and weigh 13–18 g.
sections.habitat: It has been trapped in humid evergreen forest, including primary forest near streams in Peru.
sections.diet: Its feeding habits have not been documented in the species account consulted.
sections.behavior: It is elusive and likely nocturnal and arboreal; very little behavior has been observed directly.
sections.reproduction: The available species account provides no confirmed details of its reproductive cycle.
sections.ecology: Only scattered localities are documented, and the apparent gaps may reflect the difficulty of trapping this small, rarely collected opossum.
sections.conservation: The IUCN Red List assesses the species as Least Concern.
